mentions.name: engineered.at
mentions.description: A Hacker News-style website that aggregates content exclusively from engineering blogs, both personal and company blogs, ingested via collected RSS feeds; about 600 of 3,000 collected feeds are loaded so far, with the full list to be added after tweaking.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been iterating on nights and weekends on a hackers news like website that sources all content from engineering blogs (both personal and company blogs). I have about 600 of the total 3k rss feeds I’ve collected over time loaded up, just tweaking things as I go before dropping the whole list in there: https://engineered.at
